name: Shizune
source:
Shizune is a Jonin of Konohagakure. Shizune is a fair-skinned woman of average height and slender build with onyx eyes and jet-black hair. An apprentice of the legendary Sannin [url=https://vndb.org/c105096]Tsunade[/url], Shizune became a talented medical-nin under her tutelage; also becoming her companion during her sabbatical from active shinobi duty. After Tsunade is persuaded to return to Konoha to become its Fifth Hokage, Shizune assumes the role of her assistant. She would continue these duties later for the Sixth and [url=https://vndb.org/c105088]Seventh Hokage[/url] as well.
